checks: Independently decoded all eight UWOP_SAVE_NONVOL code offsets and stack slots against actual MOV stores, plus UWOP_ALLOC_LARGE against SUB RSP,108.
All fifteen GPRs are saved after original IMUL; helper Mission is saved RDI at+50 and signed index is saved RAX at+20. RCX restoration preserves original IMUL result.
XMM0..5 spills are above helper shadow space and within the fixed frame. XMM6..15 preservation relies on the ordinary Windows x64 callee ABI.
Standard CALL enters with RSP8mod16; fixed108 frame restores alignment before helper CALL. Canonical ADD RSP,108;RET balances it.
Original tail ADD RSP,20 overwrites arithmetic flags before POP/RET; this does not establish generic flag preservation at arbitrary sites.
Registered synthetic entry range ends2020, matching32 emitted bytes. Unwind table lifetime ends before executable memory release, including constructor failure cleanup.

helperLifetimeReview: write_flag validates Mission identity, signed index and occupied primary-domain handle; it retains ReadLease through Agent+580 store and returns no Agent pointer.
The active storage pointer is published before task creation and unchanged until all tasks join; this fixture does not claim a general concurrent registry.
Held helper lease excludes storage growth, release and close through the storage mutex. Shared promises and release-guard ordering cover timeout/task-start exception cleanup.
Closed/invalid/foreign/secondary-only indices and injected helper failure produce no write; stale integer IDs intentionally resolve the current generation.
All five borrowed arrays remain owned through teardown, while newly constructed payloads are destroyed and allocations released.

limitations: Isolated generated executable stub and synthetic payloads only; no game launch, native Agent construction, installed patch or whole-engine synchronization proof.
A shared read lease protects lifetime but does not serialize concurrent non-atomic writes to the same payload byte. Actual engine write ownership or extra synchronization remains required.
Incoming/interior branch closure, detour installation, real Mission registry and lifetime barrier are not established.
Only one exact byte-write consumer is routed. Other native pointer, iteration, cache, metadata and protocol consumers are separate work.
Unwind checks exercise instruction-boundary context recovery, not arbitrary native exception-handler execution or all asynchronous contexts.
